speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough and shortness of breath for about three months now. It gets noticeably worse when I climb stairs or do other physical activities, but it doesn't seem to bother me at night. However, hospital policy during the current surge is to avoid non-essential labs. Cardiac diagnosis must be made from clinical evaluation only.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that detail; the exertional nature of your symptoms is significant. Since non-essential labs are restricted, could you describe the specific quality of your cough (dry vs. productive) and whether you notice any swelling in your legs or ankles?
